verdict.rationale: Twenty documents record deletion through its API, including batch deletes of up to 60 records per request. It also offers self-hosting so organizations can own their data end to end, which gives some control over deletion and where data lives. There is no documented retention-policy feature such as automatic purge or TTLs, no workspace or account deletion flow, and nothing on how AI-processed data is retained. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies/auto-deletion, documented workspace/account deletion and data-erasure guarantees, retention controls for AI interaction data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Both REST and GraphQL support batching up to 60 records per request — create, update, or delete.
Privacy-conscious organizations — you need to self-host and own your data end to end.
Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with a single Docker Compose command.
